parts:
Hi Yu,

Thanks a lot. Now the NA problem has been resolved. But when I used the above tree to run the command "ggtree(beast) + geom_range(range="height_0.95_HPD", color='red', alpha=.6, size=2)", it raised error ("Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : 找不到对象'height'") and failed to plot tree. In fact, the beast contained height_0.95_HPD. Why?

Best
Bin

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: got NA values of "height_0.95_HPD" when read beast formatted tree
parts: this is expected as geom_range is designed to visualize uncertainty of any evolutionary inference. When you specifying a range, it will search for corresponding variable (height here) to re-scale the tree branch.
On Wed, Nov 1, 2017 at 2:52 PM, Bin Lu <binl...@gmail.com> wrote:

Thanks a lot. Now the NA problem has been resolved. Best
Bin
